caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent, light blue-green glass goblet positioned centrally on a plain, beige background. The goblet has a wide, outward-flaring rim, a gently curving bowl that becomes narrower toward the base, and a short, thick stem that sits on a broad, flat, circular foot. The glass features subtle shadow and highlight details to suggest its transparency and reflective nature. There are no additional objects or decorative elements present in the composition, and the overall style is realistic. Near the lower left corner of the beige background, there is a faint handwritten word.
title: Blown Glass
